title: Roundcube Webmail before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in…
description: Roundcube Webmail versions before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contain a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the compose_part_body() function. This function converts a text/enriched message part to HTML for the HTML editor without proper sanitization. An attacker can exploit this by sending a crafted email containing a malicious script in the text/enriched part, which executes in the victim's session when they reply to, forward, or edit the message.
